title: System Health Engineer III/Senior
description:
Arizona Public Service generates clean, reliable and affordable energy for 2.7 million Arizonans. Our service territory stretches across the state, from the border town of Douglas to the vistas of the Grand Canyon, from the solar fields of Gila Bend to the ponderosa pines of Payson. As the state’s largest and longest-serving energy provider, our more than 6,000 dedicated employees power our vision of creating a sustainable energy future for Arizona.

Since our founding in 1886, APS has demonstrated a strong commitment to our customers in one of the country’s fastest growing states, earning a reputation for customer satisfaction, shareholder value, operational excellence and business integrity.

Our present and future success depends on the creative and dedicated people of our company who demonstrate the principles outlined in the APS Promise: Design for Tomorrow, Empower Each Other and Succeed Together.

Summary

We are seeking a System Health Engineer III/Senior to join our asset management and maintenance support organization. This team is dedicated to applying maintenance best practices, leveraging asset analytics, and evaluating operational outcomes to maximize the useful life of critical equipment—both inside and outside the substation fence.

In this role, you’ll combine your technical expertise and analytical mindset to evaluate equipment health, identify performance issues, and develop strategies that enhance reliability and longevity. You’ll collaborate closely with maintenance, operations, and engineering teams to make data-driven recommendations that optimize asset performance across our power system.

The Engineer III/Senior:

  • Provides technical engineering, design, economic and analytical support to participate in the development of long-range system plans and conducting of engineering requests, proposals and presentations.
  • Performs engineering tasks requiring skills and experience gained through application of engineering methods and analysis.
  • Has increasing responsibility for technical decisions and interpretations. Provides technical guidance and leadership to others as needed.
  • Should have a strong understanding of transmission engineering and maintenance, and asset management in the transmission space.
  • May be subject to shift work.

Minimum Requirements

Level III

  • Bachelor of Science degree in an engineering discipline or related applied science discipline
  • Plus five (5) years working experience in Engineering-related positions.
  • Approved Engineer degrees: Materials Science/Metallurgy, Physics, Chemistry, Math, Nuclear, Electrical, Mechanical, Civil, Electronics, Computer Science, Environmental, Chemical, Architectural, Structural. (A four-year bachelor of Engineering Technology degree is not considered an automatic equivalent for a B.S. degree in Engineering. A review of the degree program curriculum must be completed by Engineering department management.

Senior

  • A four year Bachelor of Science degree in an engineering discipline or related applied science discipline (see approved list) from an ABET accredited institution
  • plus eight (8) years working experience in Engineering-related positions.
  • Approved degrees: Materials Science/Metallurgy, Physics, Chemistry, Math, Nuclear, Electrical, Mechanical, Civil, Electronics, Computer Science, Environmental, Chemical, Architectural, Structural. (A four-year bachelor of Engineering Technology degree is not considered an automatic equivalent for a B.S. degree in Engineering. A review of the degree program curriculum must be completed by Engineering department management

Preferred Special Skills, Knowledge or Qualifications:

  • Knowledge of equipment maintenance and testing strategies in transmission and distribution equipment.
  • Familiarity with strategic asset management.
  • Problem analysis/resolution techniques.
  • Knowledge of applicable codes, standards, practices, methods and safety standards in the area of applicable engineering discipline.
  • Experience in the utility industry.
  • Professional Engineer licensure.

Major Accountabilities

1) Prepares engineering plans, designs, analysis, specifications, cost estimates, evaluations, studies, technical reviews, investigations and verifications. Complies with design, regulatory, operating and maintenance requirements. Ensures engineering analyses, design, project control, schedule commitments, or oversight work is technically sound, cost effective, and in compliance with established standards, codes, and regulations. Checks and reviews analysis, evaluations, and investigations of others.
2) Interfaces with customers and other departments to ensure project objectives are understood and that work scope meets customer requirements, budget and schedule. Contacts customers and various levels of management to obtain or present technical data. Presents the results of designs, studies projects (in terms of new techniques) or approaches to subordinates, colleagues, management and customers.
3) Enhances department performance and productivity and/or unit performance by formulating, coordinating, performing analysis and making recommendations for improvements. Provides technical assistance and guidance to department personnel to enhance department performance and productivity.
4) May provide oversight of engineering technical programs by managing the program requirements, working with cross organizational partners, reviewing and internalizing operating experience and coordinating corrective actions to ensure engineering program elements continue to remain healthy.
5) May assume responsibility for small- to medium-scale projects which include planning, designing, scheduling and coordinating all facets of the project. Identifies potential schedule or quality problems and initiates corrective action. Takes initiative to eliminate barriers and uses resources to ensure desired results. May interface with outside agencies and regulatory authorities.
6) Provides technical guidance and leadership to less experienced engineers.
7) May participate in developing long-range strategies for significant site problems.
8) Provides input to projects and recommends modifications to increase operating efficiency and/or reviews design and documentation of projects to ensure compliance with design specifications, schedules and any regulatory requirements.
9) Remains cognizant of current technology and engineering developments as well as industry and competitive developments.
10) Creation of asset management and business case documentation in order to justify maintenance strategies for new and existing asset classes.

description:
• Systems Engineer – Technical Capability Lead – Porton Down (SP4) – Permanent – Full Time

    • Salary £50,000 - £80,000 DOE
    • 25 days annual leave (inclusive of up to 3 days December shutdown)
    • Buy or sell up to 5 days’ annual leave
    • Two pension schemes to choose from
    • Two pension schemes to choose from

    • Life Assurance scheme up to 4 x salary
    • Multiple Save schemes
    • Electric/Hybrid Car leasing scheme
    • Cycle to work scheme
    • Retail discounts
    • Continuous Professional development support
    • Annual Wellness Allowance

    About the role

    Are you an experienced Systems Engineer or technical specialist with recent hands-on experience of complex defence, aerospace or military aviation systems? Do you have technical expertise in DAS or a related capability, with experience across systems engineering, test and evaluation, analysis or assurance?

    At MASS, you’ll join our team and work directly on-site with our customer, Dstl, at Porton Down (SP4), 5 days a week. You’ll become the technical focal point and subject matter expert for an assigned reference capability (one of: IR Threat Warning, Directed IR Countermeasure, or the Controller for the overall DAS system), working with Dstl, MOD stakeholders, industry partners and platform integration teams to understand technical issues, identify risks and provide sound technical advice.

    The role requires some travel within the UK to liaise with stakeholders in MOD and industry.

    What you’ll be doing

    You’ll use your systems engineering expertise across capability understanding, technical engagement, integration, test and evaluation, analysis and assurance.

    • Develop and maintain a detailed understanding of your assigned capability, including its architecture, interfaces and performance.
    • Review technical specifications, engineering documentation and test evidence.
    • Work with Dstl, industry suppliers and MOD stakeholders to understand technical developments, risks and opportunities.
    • Support platform integration, technical investigations and the resolution of engineering challenges.
    • Contribute to laboratory testing, field trials and technical assurance activities.
    • Assess system performance against requirements and operational needs.
    • Analyse technical and operational data to produce clear recommendations.
    • Prepare technical reports, briefings and presentations for stakeholders.
    • Capture technical knowledge and lessons learned to support knowledge transfer.

    How you’ll support us

    Your technical expertise will help make informed decisions throughout the capability lifecycle. You’ll help assess system performance, identify technical risks, support robust test and evaluation, and contribute to the effective integration of defence capabilities onto operational platforms.

    The invaluable experience you’ll bring, to help us achieve more

    We’re looking for someone with recent, hands-on technical experience of complex defence, aerospace or military aviation systems who can apply their expertise directly to a DAS or related capability.

    Essential experience

    • Significant recent experience in systems engineering, systems integration, test and evaluation, analysis, assurance or a related technical discipline.
    • Technical knowledge relevant to DAS, electronic warfare, defensive aids, threat warning, countermeasures or a closely related defence/aerospace capability.
    • Demonstrable technical depth in at least one of the following areas: systems engineering, test and evaluation, technical analysis, systems assurance, integration or performance assessment.
    • Strong understanding of the air domain, including platforms and threat systems.
    • Experience working with complex defence, aerospace, military aviation or other high-technology systems.
    • Experience with system architectures, interfaces and integration challenges.
    • Experience reviewing technical specifications, engineering documentation and/or test evidence.
    • Experience supporting testing, trials, verification, validation, analysis or technical assurance activities.
    • Strong technical analysis, stakeholder engagement and communication skills, with the ability to produce clear technical reports and recommendations.

    Desirable experience

    • Experience working with MOD or defence industry programmes.
    • Experience supporting platform integration activities.
    • Understanding of systems engineering lifecycle processes.
    • Experience in operational analysis, performance assessment or technical risk management.

    Security requirements:

    As this role involves working on secure projects with Dstl, there are a couple of requirements we need you to meet:

    • You must be a UK National and eligible to work in the UK
    • You must be eligible to obtain and maintain UK Government Security Check (SC) clearance

    Who is MASS?

    MASS is an independent technology company trusted by highly secure organisations to deliver advanced digital services that manage data and keep information safe. With our heritage in defence, we bring extensive security expertise to organisations where protecting information and maintaining resilience are essential.

    We work closely with our customers, combining technical expertise with innovative thinking to deliver tailored, agile and resilient solutions. Our people are at the heart of what we do, bringing the skills and experience needed to help our customers navigate complex challenges and stay ready for digital transformation.

    Wellbeing is an important part of our culture. We want our people to feel supported and able to thrive, which is why we offer a range of wellbeing initiatives, including mental health first aiders and access to our extensive Employee Assistance Programme.

    MASS is an equal opportunities employer. We value the different skills, experience and perspectives our people bring, and aim to create a friendly and inclusive workplace where everyone feels valued and has the opportunity to make a real impact.

    Apply today to see how working for MASS could work for you!

description:
Nyköping och Eskilstuna

Om oss
Regionservice är en smidig, flexibel och nytänkande serviceorganisation med stolta medarbetare, som tillsammans skapar värde för Region Sörmland.

Vi arbetar inom områdena; fastigheter och lokaler, inköp, löne- och fakturahantering, administration, informationshantering och verksamhetsnära service som kost, transport, lokalvård och vårdnära service.

Tjänsten ingår i Stöd och utveckling som har i uppdrag är att stötta övriga verksamheter inom Regionservice med utveckling.

Dina arbetsuppgifter
• Medverka i förvaltning och utveckling av verksamhetskritiska IT-system
• Analysera tekniska problem, systemberoenden och informationsflöden.
• Identifiera verksamhetsbehov och omsätta dem till tekniska krav och lösningsförslag.
• Arbeta med integrationer och informationsöverföring mellan system.
• Bidra vid utvärdering, införande och vidareutveckling av digitala lösningar.
• Stödja chefer och verksamheter i frågor som rör IT-stöd och digital utveckling.
• Samordna mindre och medelstora utvecklingsinsatser.
• Samverka med IT-organisation, systemleverantörer och andra berörda funktioner.


Din kompetens
Vi söker dig som har:
• Relevant högskoleutbildning inom IT, systemvetenskap eller motsvarande, alternativt likvärdiga kunskaper förvärvade på annat sätt.
• Erfarenhet av förvaltning, utveckling eller teknisk kravställning av komplexa IT-system.
• God förståelse för integrationer, informationsflöden och tekniska beroenden.
• Erfarenhet av teknisk analys och problemlösning.
• Förmåga att omsätta verksamhetsbehov till tydliga tekniska krav och lösningar.
• Förståelse för samspelet mellan verksamhetssystem, klientplattformar och användarnära utrustning.


Det är meriterande om du har erfarenhet av:
• Verksamhetskritiska system inom exempelvis fastighetsförvaltning, materialförsörjning, bokning eller serviceverksamhet.
• Mobila verksamhetslösningar där telefoner, surfplattor eller handenheter ingår.
• API:er, databaser och strukturerade informationsflöden.
• Leverantörssamverkan, informationssäkerhet eller behörighetsstyrning.
• Ekonomisk grundkunskap avseende debitering och kontering.


För att lyckas i rollen behöver du ha ett tydligt tekniskt intresse. Du arbetar självständigt och strukturerat och har lätt för att snabbt sätta dig in i nya system och frågeställningar. Eftersom du arbetar i gränslandet mellan verksamhet och IT behöver du vara samarbetsinriktad, serviceorienterad och pedagogisk. Du kan förklara tekniska frågor på ett begripligt sätt och skapa goda relationer med såväl verksamhetsrepresentanter som tekniska specialister och leverantörer.
Vi lägger stor vikt vid personliga egenskaper.


Anställningsform
Vi erbjuder dig en vikariatsanställning på cirka 1 år. Tillträde enligt överenskommelse.

Information om tjänsten lämnas av
Verksamhetschef Lisa Sollenborn, lisa.sollenborn@regionsormland.se, 072-083 03 93.
Fackliga företrädare söks via Kontaktcenter, 0155-24 50 00.

Välkommen med din ansökan, inklusive CV, senast 2026-11-04.
Intervjuer kan komma att ske löpande.

Det kan ske på två sätt, endera begär regionen ut uppgiften själv eller också uppmanas du att begära ut utdrag för att kunna visa upp innan anställning. Vi begär i undantagsfall att du visar upp registerutdrag även vid tillsättning av andra tjänster än de som avses ovan. Blir du aktuell för anställning kommer du att informeras om vad som gäller för den tjänst du sökt.

Du som har skyddade personuppgifter bör vara aktsam med vilken information som du delar i din ansökan. Ta kontakt med den kontaktperson som finns angiven i annonsen innan du skickar in din ansökan.

title: Care & Maintenance Coordinator - Bristol
description:
• About The Role

  • Altrad are seeking an experienced and highly organised Care & Maintenance Coordinator to support the safe, compliant and effective delivery of Care & Maintenance (C&M) activities within the warehouse facility at Sizewell C.

    This role will be based at Sizewell C on a permanent basis and will act as the focal point for day-to-day C&M activities being delivered within the warehouse. Working closely with the C&M team, LLP, IP Operatives, Construction Engineers, Client Project Managers and other stakeholders, you will coordinate work packs, permits, authorisations, resources and enabling services to ensure activities are properly planned, safely executed and effectively recorded. The role will also provide on-site HSE leadership, oversee workforce engagement and support the resolution of operational issues, findings and NCRs.

    Key Deliverables / Accountabilities:

    • Act as the focal point for day-to-day C&M activities being delivered at the warehouse facility.
    • Support the C&M team with the planning and preparation of C&M work packs, permits and other required authorisations.
    • Ensure the safe and effective coordination and execution of C&M activities within the warehouse.
    • Coordinate with the IPS and LLP to facilitate C&M personnel attending the warehouse, including enabling services, work areas, consumables and tooling.
    • Coordinate access arrangements with the LLP.
    • Coordinate the supply and storage of tooling and consumables through the LLP, including the timely provision, review and acceptance of COSHH assessments.
    • Coordinate LLP IP Operative visits, inductions, Duty Holder cover and issue resolution.
    • Raise SONIM requests and coordinate with relevant third parties.
    • Oversee operational readiness and workforce engagement across C&M activities.
    • Supervise C&M teams on site and work with the LLP to maintain a safe, compliant and well-controlled working environment.
    • Report C&M progress, activities and status to relevant stakeholders.
    • Ensure the timely capture, organisation and submission of C&M records.
    • Maintain the C&M Findings Log and coordinate with Construction Engineers and Client Project Managers to support timely resolution.
    • Implement Standard Field Solution Work Packs where required.
    • Work with relevant stakeholders to resolve operational issues and challenges and support the close-out of C&M findings and NCRs.
    • Act as the on-site HSE operational lead, providing supervision and support while embedding a robust and effective safety culture.
    • Ensure HSE is prioritised across all C&M activities and that appropriate Duty Holder cover and local HSE arrangements are in place with LLP support.
    • Coordinate the implementation of the Safe System of Work, work authorisation and Permit to Work requests, including the approval of concurrent work requests.
    • Conduct HSE checks during weekly walkdowns and report any deviations or areas requiring corrective action.
    • Coordinate daily, weekly, monthly and quarterly safety meetings.
    • Log incidents and accidents and track associated corrective actions through to completion.
    • Communicate relevant safety alerts to C&M teams and stakeholders.
    • Ensure induction processes comply with approved standards and project requirements.
    • Act as Supervisor of the IP Operatives.
    • Deliver Toolbox Talks and Daily Activity Briefs with LLP support.
    • Ensure completion and verification of PoWRA requirements.
    • Conduct regular pre-shift walkdowns with LLP support.
    • Coordinate with the LLP and IP Operatives in relation to setting to work activities.
    • Oversee and enforce appropriate standards of housekeeping throughout the warehouse and work areas.
    • Monitor and document the effectiveness of issue resolution.
    • Provide learning, feedback and support the implementation of continuous improvement initiatives across C&M activities.

    Key Requirements / Qualifications:

    • Engineering background with relevant experience applied to Care & Maintenance activities.
    • Strong HSE background with a detailed understanding of UK regulations applicable to warehouse and maintenance activities.
    • IOSH Managing Safely or equivalent, as a minimum requirement.
    • Expert user of Microsoft Excel and other databases, with demonstrable data manipulation, numerical and analytical skills.
    • Excellent presentation, influencing and facilitation skills.
    • Strong communication and organisational skills, with the ability to develop relationships and maintain effective stakeholder networks.
    • Strong understanding of procurement and logistics activities.
    • Strong understanding of passive and active Care & Maintenance activities.
    • Understanding of pertinent ONR Licence Conditions and their application.
    • Proven experience successfully engaging and coordinating groups of stakeholders.
    • Ability to work effectively in a safety-critical and highly regulated environment.
    • Strong ability to manage competing priorities, resolve issues proactively and maintain accurate records and reporting.

3 redenen om voor deze job te kiezen

Zo ziet je job er uit

    • Creëren en vertellen: je maakt foto's, carrousels, Reels, Stories en TikToks. Je neemt zelf video's op en monteert ze (interviews, dag-in-het-leven, behind the scenes) en je begeleidt collega's en klanten voor de camera. Af en toe sta je zelf in beeld.

  • Energiek, sociaal, ondernemend en met de vinger aan de pols van de onlinewereld: dat ben jij.

title: IT Director
description:
Perigon Group is partnering with an established, purpose-led organisation to recruit an experienced IT Director to lead its technology function.

Based in Sydney, the organisation delivers services that make a positive impact on the community. This is an opportunity to shape technology strategy, strengthen internal capability and drive improvements across systems, security and business processes.

The Role

Working within a lean internal team supported by external technology providers, you will provide strategic direction and ensure technology services remain secure, reliable and aligned with business needs.

The focus is on technology leadership, governance and supplier management, rather than day-to-day technical support or infrastructure engineering.
Reporting to a senior executive, you will lead a small internal technology function and work closely with business leaders and external partners to deliver the technology roadmap.

The Responsibilities:

  • Develop and deliver the ICT strategy and annual technology roadmap.
  • Manage technology operating and capital budgets, forecasting and procurement.
  • Oversee managed service providers and specialist technology partners, including service levels, performance reviews and escalations.
  • Maintain technology and information security policies, standards and governance frameworks.
  • Oversee cybersecurity, technology risk and remediation activities.
  • Prepare technology and cybersecurity reporting for executive leadership and Board committees.
  • Lead technology projects across collaboration platforms, information management and workplace infrastructure.
  • Oversee the performance, lifecycle and integration of core business applications.
  • Identify opportunities to improve business processes through automation, digital tools and AI.
  • Support staff adoption of Microsoft 365 and other digital platforms.
  • Develop internal technology capability and lead a small team.

The Requirements:

  • At least five years’ experience in ICT management, technology leadership or a comparable senior role.
  • Experience working within an outsourced or co-managed IT environment.
  • Broad knowledge across technology infrastructure, cybersecurity and business applications.
  • Demonstrated vendor, contract and service-performance management experience.
  • Experience developing technology strategies, roadmaps, policies and governance processes.
  • Technology budgeting, procurement and expenditure-management experience.
  • A track record of delivering technology projects, transformation or organisational change.
  • Strong communication skills and the ability to engage effectively with senior stakeholders.
  • A relevant tertiary qualification or equivalent professional experience.

Experience in a regulated or service-focused organisation would be advantageous. Exposure to Microsoft 365, SharePoint and building internal technology capability would also be highly regarded.

title: Digital Product Manager
description:
General Manager Digital Product Client Product and Partnerships

We are looking for an experienced technology and digital product leader with a strong commercial understanding to lead the technology strategy and delivery that supports our Client Product & Partnerships strategy.

As General Manager, Digital Product: Client Product & Partnerships , you will be the operating interface between Client Product, Client Partnerships and Technology within the Technology, Digital and Data function. You will translate commercial priorities into clear, prioritised and scalable technology delivery, leading the operating rhythm from opportunity through launch, optimisation and continuous improvement.

You will own technical delivery across a portfolio including video, commercial content, commercial data, ecommerce whilst incorporating advertising solutions,. You will ensure these capabilities integrate effectively with News Corp Australia’s audience proposition and create measurable value for audiences, advertisers and the business.

The role will lead dedicated web and app squads across product management, engineering, design and delivery. You will lead technology strategy, align priorities, remove barriers and create the conditions for high-quality execution across multiple initiatives. You will also mobilise capabilities across the wider Technology organisation when required.

AdTech does not sit within this function. However, you will work closely with the AdTech team and other technology partners to ensure strong alignment, effective integration and coordinated delivery across the broader commercial technology ecosystem.

Based in Technology, you will work closely with Client Product and Client Partnerships leadership, contribute insight and recommendations to strategic planning and investment decisions, and lead the technology response to agreed priorities. You will engage with executive leaders, clients and partners as required.

Success in this role will require experienced leadership, operating excellence, commercial judgement and the ability to turn complex priorities into focused plans, measurable outcomes and high‑quality digital experiences.

What you will do

  • Lead technology strategy: Develop and lead the technology strategy, priorities and delivery approach that support the Client Product & Partnerships strategy and agreed business outcomes.
  • Lead technical delivery: Own the delivery of Client Product technology capabilities across advertising solutions, video, commercial content, commercial data propositions and ecommerce.
  • Lead delivery teams: Lead dedicated web and app squads across product management, engineering, design and delivery, creating clarity, accountability and the conditions for high‐quality execution.
  • Connect commercial priorities with technology delivery: Translate Sales, Client Partnerships and Client Product priorities into clear technology plans, sequencing, dependencies and outcomes.
  • Partner with AdTech: Work closely with the AdTech team and other technology partners to support alignment, integration and coordinated delivery, while recognising that AdTech sits outside this function.
  • Integrate commercial and audience capabilities: Ensure commercial capabilities work effectively with the audience proposition, enhancing the consumer experience while meeting advertiser and business outcomes.
  • Build and scale capability: Support the development and scaling of differentiated products, propositions, partnerships and technology‑enabled services using data, technology and emerging capabilities.
  • Establish delivery governance: Provide clear prioritisation, governance, delivery visibility, risk management and performance measures across the client delivery lifecycle.
  • Contribute to investment decisions: Bring technology insight, delivery implications, options, risks and recommendations to investment discussions and planning processes.
  • Drive cross‑functional alignment: Manage and influence teams within and beyond direct reporting lines, aligning TDD, Client Partnerships, Client Product, AdTech and the wider business.
  • Maintain an outside‑in perspective: Monitor relevant innovation, technology advances and emerging practices across advertising, media and technology, translating useful opportunities into action.
  • Contribute to strategic leadership: Participate in executive discussions and build strong relationships across News Corp to share best practice, leverage shared capabilities and support innovation at scale.

Who are you?

  • Experienced leader: Significant leadership experience across technology, digital product, engineering, delivery or a related field, with a track record of leading complex, multi‑disciplinary teams.
  • Strong commercial understanding: The ability to understand commercial objectives, client needs, audience value and business performance, and translate them into practical technology priorities.
  • Technology strategy and delivery experience: A proven track record of leading technology strategy and delivering complex, cross‑functional initiatives from prioritisation through to execution and measurable impact.
  • Portfolio leadership: Experience overseeing delivery across multiple products, platforms, capabilities or initiatives, ideally across web and app environments.
  • Commercial product and partnership experience: Experience working at the intersection of digital product, commercial partnerships, advertising, media, ecommerce, data or technology‑enabled services.
  • AdTech and ecosystem awareness: Understanding of advertising technology and experience partnering effectively with AdTech or adjacent technology teams is preferred.
  • Executive engagement: Experience working with senior executives, clients, partners and stakeholders across direct and indirect reporting lines.
  • Investment and prioritisation experience: Experience contributing technology advice, options and recommendations to investment, prioritisation or planning decisions.
  • Scaling capability: Experience building, launching or scaling products, propositions, partnerships, platforms or technology‑enabled services.
  • Collaborative leadership: The ability to lead through influence, build trust across organisational boundaries and operate as a pragmatic, outcome‑focused leader.

Why News Corp Australia

Join a culture where innovation is our operating rhythm. You’ll work on a diverse portfolio of Australia’s most loved brands and play a pivotal role in leading the technological shift in how we create commercial content. Our vibrant, hybrid work environment and dynamic, values‑driven culture empowers you to push boundaries, collaborate as one unified team, and make a positive, measurable impact for all Australians.

News Extras Benefits is a commitment to our people for their valued contribution to News, our audiences, clients and communities.

Our benefits include:

  • Exclusively ours - Access to publications and products from across the News Corp family
  • Perks & discounts - Exclusive offers across a range of products and services that deliver genuine cost savings and benefits
  • Health & wellbeing - Advice, support and facilities for healthy minds and bodies (including an onsite gym at our Adelaide, Brisbane & Sydney offices)
  • Time off - News offers a range of leave options to support your personal needs and moments that matter in life: Parental leave, Birthday leave, Volunteer leave, Career break and Compassionate leave.
  • Financial wellbeing - Support on making the most of your money

In addition to our perks and benefits, employees have access to a number of initiatives and programs that support their wellbeing and professional growth, such as:

  • Helping you grow - Access tailored development opportunities, including leadership programs, to cultivate your skills and support your career
  • Giving back - Make a difference to our communities through volunteer opportunities and company‑organised charity drives
  • Workplace Inclusion and facilities – Engage with your passions through various employee‑resource groups and accessibility to multi‑faith quiet rooms & parents’ rooms

Who are we?

We are proud to be Australia’s most impactful media group, we’re even prouder of what we stand for: Together, we inform, advocate and inspire all Australians, for a better Australia. In an evolving media industry our brands continue to drive the story and influence the agenda - 7.4 million Australians read one of our national, metro or regional paid daily titles a week. We are proud to be the greatest storytellers in Australia. Our products are innovative and dynamic, constantly adapting to new challenges and pioneering the way forward to lead the market. A fast paced and ever changing environment requires adequate, robust and reliable business systems and processes which play a vital part in our success.

title: Data engineer
description:
Vill du använda din kompetens och ditt engagemang till att skapa digitala lösningar för Skolsektorn i Sverige, samtidigt som du bidrar till Skolverkets digitala utveckling? Vi söker dig som är en erfaren och driven data engineer som kan arbeta både strategiskt och operativt med fokus på datalager och integration. Var med och bidra till skolans framtid!

Om jobbet

Hos oss är arbete med data och analys centralt. Vi vill utöka vår förmåga inom dataintag och dataanalys och där har du en viktig roll. Som data engineer bidrar du både operativt och taktiskt till vår digitala förflyttning inom datalager, datahantering, och dataanalys samt tillhörande integrationsarkitektur. Du arbetar praktiskt med att analysera behov, utforma lösningar och omsätta dem i genomförbara strukturer inom datalager och integration.

Du förenar verksamhetsförståelse och teknisk bredd genom att identifiera behov, analysera förutsättningar och ta fram hållbara lösningsförslag och strukturer anpassade till olika sammanhang. Du är också delaktig i att utforma de lösningar som Skolverket erbjuder skolväsendet, med fokus på att utveckla lösningar för datahantering med direkt verksamhetsvärde.

Du bidrar även aktivt till Skolverkets digitala utvecklingsarbete. Tillsammans med kollegorna inom datafunktionen säkerställer du kvalitet, konsistens och integritet i myndighetens centrala dataobjekt.

Du arbetar i ett tvärfunktionellt team där andra data engineers, informations- och dataarkitekter ingår. Du har även ett nära samarbete med kollegorna inom enheten, avdelningen och andra delar av Skolverket samt externa kontakter. Det här är en roll för dig som trivs i en föränderlig miljö där allt inte är färdigt.

* * * * *

”Som en del av vårt team får du inte bara möjlighet att använda din tekniska expertis, utan även vara med och bidra till utveckling av information- och datahantering internt på myndigheten och på nationell nivå. Vi ser fram emot att välkomna en ny kollega som delar vårt engagemang för att skapa nytta och förbättringar för våra användare.”

-Robert Modén , enhetschef

* * * * *

Du tillhör Enheten för förvaltning och systemutveckling inom it-avdelningen. På vår it-avdelning jobbar drygt 100 personer med att säkerställa en fungerande och säker it-miljö samt med att stötta verksamheten genom utveckling och förvaltning av it-stöd, infrastruktur och arbetssätt för digital utveckling.

Du arbetar på vårt moderna och rymliga kontor i Solna Business Park. Du kan också ha möjlighet att arbeta upp till 50% på distans.

Om dig

För att göra ett bra jobb och trivas hos oss behöver du stå för och leva upp till den statliga värdegrunden och till våra kärnvärden för medarbetarskap: förebild, tillit, ansvar, samarbete och utveckling. Läs mer på www.skolverket.se/jobb

I det här jobbet ska du ha

eftergymnasial utbildning inom it eller annan utbildning i kombination med erfarenhet som Skolverket bedömer är relevant,
mycket goda kunskaper om datamodellering med fokus på både datalager och generell systemdesign,
flerårig aktuell erfarenhet av att arbeta med systemutveckling i Python,
erfarenhet av utveckling och orkestrering av datapipelines i Python,
flerårig erfarenhet av att bygga och underhålla stabila data pipelines i olika miljöer,
praktisk erfarenhet av att analysera verksamhetens behov av data för utveckling av rapportlösningar,
relevant erfarenhet av arbete med datastrukturer, algoritmer och principer för mjukvaruutveckling,
god erfarenhet av SQL och arbete med komplexa datamängder,
god erfarenhet av mönster för datainhämtning (datainläsningsarkitektur),
mycket goda kunskaper i svenska i tal och skrift samt goda kunskaper i engelska.

Det är meriterande att du har erfarenhet av containerbaserade lösningar, exempelvis Docker eller Kubernetes, erfarenhet av att sätta upp målgruppsanpassade visualiseringar i Power BI eller motsvarande verktyg samt erfarenhet av arbete i offentlig sektor eller med stora, komplexa informationsmiljöer.

Som person behöver du

ha en god förmåga att analysera behov och omsätta dessa i hållbara och relevanta lösningsförslag,
ha ett driv att nå resultat,
god förmåga att planera ditt arbete,
vara bra på att samarbeta och bygga förtroende i gränssnittet mellan verksamhet och teknik

Viktigt att veta

Sista ansökningsdag är 16 november. Anställningen är tillsvidare och inleds med provanställning i sex månader.

När du registrerar din ansökan får du svara på några frågor i stället för att bifoga ett personligt brev. Läs gärna igenom ansökningsformuläret och förbered dina svar innan du gör ansökan.

Skolverket arbetar för att alla barn och elever ska få en bra och likvärdig utbildning i en trygg miljö. Vi stödjer på olika sätt den svenska förskolan, skolan och komvux. Som medarbetare på Skolverket är du med och bidrar till att skapa goda förutsättningar för barns och elevers utveckling och lärande. Lär känna oss bättre genom att besöka vår webbplats www.skolverket.se/jobb. Vårt uppdrag – skolans framtid.

title: Business Analyst - Temenos T24 & TAP
description:
Project description

This role will be part of the Platform and Integration Office team, supporting the Group Wealth Platform (GWP) regional rollout programme for Private Banking. GWP is the Group's integrated wealth management platform built on Temenos Transact (T24) as the core banking and wealth back-office system and Temenos Triple'A Plus (TAP) as the front- and middle-office portfolio management system, covering client investment account opening, order management and pre-trade checks, wealth product processing, portfolio management, assisted and self-service channels, and downstream data and reporting. The GWP – Business Analyst, Temenos T24 & TAP Subject Matter Expert (SME) will be the programme's go-to functional expert on the Temenos wealth product suite. The role bridges business requirements and the Temenos solution, ensuring that business needs are met through standard product capability and model bank configuration wherever possible, and that gaps, customisations and workarounds are clearly understood, justified and governed. The ideal candidate will bring deep hands-on knowledge of T24 and TAP, gained through one or more end-to-end Temenos implementations for private banks or wealth managers in the Asia Pacific (APAC) market. He/she will apply this experience to fit-gap analysis, solution design review, T24–TAP integration, data migration, testing and go-live readiness across markets at different stages of rollout, while also advising on APAC market practices and local regulatory needs. The candidate is expected to demonstrate strong discipline in business analysis and documentation, and to be able to work well within a team and yet take initiative and ownership over his/her own area of work assignments or projects.

Responsibilities

  • Act as the functional SME for Temenos T24 and TAP across the programme, advising business and project teams on standard product capability, model bank configuration and industry best practice for private banking and wealth management.
  • Lead requirement workshops and fit-gap analysis against T24 and TAP, and translate business needs into Business Requirement Documents (BRD), process flows and business rules that are aligned with Temenos capability; recommend configuration-first solutions and challenge unnecessary customisation.
  • Review Functional Specification Documents (FSD) and solution designs with IT business analysts, architects, Temenos and implementation partners; independently challenge and validate IT's proposed T24 and TAP solutions, customisations, workarounds and effort estimates to ensure they are fit-for-purpose, aligned to standard product capability and meet business intent, and drive closure of requirement gaps and deviations.
  • Provide T24 functional expertise across customer and account set-up, securities and portfolio (SC), funds, bonds, FX, money market and deposits, corporate actions, fees and charges, safekeeping, settlement, accounting and wealth financing / lending (e.g. Lombard and overdraft facilities).
  • Provide TAP functional expertise across portfolio and mandate set-up, advisory and discretionary portfolio management (DPM), model portfolios and rebalancing, order management, pre-trade and investment compliance checks, suitability and risk profiling, performance measurement and client reporting.
  • Define and validate integration requirements between T24, TAP and surrounding systems such as order management, channels, market data, custodians and brokers, payments, and downstream data, finance and regulatory reporting, including interface timing, data ownership and reconciliation.
  • Support data migration by defining T24 and TAP data mapping, transformation rules and reconciliation criteria for clients, portfolios, positions, cash balances and static data, and by validating mock and dress rehearsal migration results.
  • Formulate SIT and UAT scope, end-to-end test scenarios and test cases across the T24 and TAP trade and portfolio lifecycle; support test execution, defect triage and root-cause analysis, and coordinate business sign-off.
  • Support go-live operational readiness, cutover and hypercare, including SOP updates, user roles and entitlement design, production issue triage, and handover of accepted gaps and enhancements into the BAU platform backlog.
  • Advise on APAC market localisation for new market rollouts, including local product features, market and settlement practices, tax and regulatory reporting needs, and assess their impact on the regional T24 and TAP baseline.
  • Prepare training material and user guides on T24 and TAP functions, deliver knowledge transfer to business users, operations and junior business analysts, and build internal Temenos capability within the team.
  • Build and maintain strong relationships with business units, technology teams, operations, compliance, Temenos and implementation partners; communicate progress, decisions and risks clearly to stakeholders at various levels of the organisation.

SKILLS

Must have

  • Bachelor's degree in Banking and Finance, Business Administration, Information Systems, Computer Science or a related field.
  • Minimum 8 years of experience in banking IT or business analysis, including at least 5 years of hands-on experience with Temenos Transact (T24) and Temenos Triple'A Plus (TAP) in private banking or wealth management.
  • Proven track record of at least one full-lifecycle T24 and/or TAP implementation in the APAC market (e.g. Singapore, Hong Kong, Indonesia, Malaysia or other Asian markets), from requirements and fit-gap through to go-live and post-implementation support.
  • In-depth functional knowledge of T24 wealth-related modules (e.g. Securities (SC), Arrangement Architecture (AA), FX, Money Market, Derivatives (DX), Corporate Actions, Lending) and of TAP portfolio management, order management, investment compliance and reporting capabilities.
  • Proven ability to challenge and validate IT T24 solution designs, including functional specifications, parameter and configuration set-up, local developments and interface designs, and to assess whether proposed solutions are fit-for-purpose, efficient and aligned with Temenos standard capability. Prior experience as an IT Business Analyst on T24 implementations will be a strong plus.
  • Solid wealth management product knowledge across bonds, equities, mutual funds, FX, structured products, deposits and wealth financing, including the trade lifecycle, booking, settlement, valuation and accounting flows.
  • Hands-on experience in data migration, SIT/UAT and cutover for core banking or wealth platform implementations.
  • Familiarity with APAC private banking market practices and regulatory requirements (e.g. MAS, HKMA, OJK) relevant to wealth products and client suitability.
  • Strong knowledge of delivery methodologies (e.g. Agile, Waterfall) and tools (e.g. JIRA, Confluence, MS Project).
  • Excellent analytical, problem-solving and documentation skills, with the ability to explain complex Temenos functions in clear business terms.
  • Exceptional communication and stakeholder management skills; able to work independently across multiple markets and locations, and willing to travel within the region as required.

Nice to have

• Temenos product certification (T24 / Transact or Triple'A Plus / Wealth) is highly desirable • Bbusiness analysis or project management certification (e.g. CBAP, PMP, Agile/Scrum) is an advantage. • Good understanding of T24–TAP integration and data flows, and familiarity with Temenos integration tools (e.g. Temenos Integration Framework, OFS, APIs) is an advantage. • Experience with T24 upgrades or Temenos Wealth / WealthSuite is a plus.

title: Global Finance Project Manager
description:
THE·TEAM is proud to provide representation and marketing services to talent, brands and properties across 28 countries and more than 70 cities worldwide.


Shaped by our belief in the unifying power of sports, music and entertainment, THE·TEAM leads with intelligence, ideas and influence. For more information, please visit the.team.




The Global Finance Transformation team drives technology-enabled transformation across Finance and Accounting, working across three core areas: Functional Systems Administration, Business Process Management and Portfolio Management.


We’re looking for a Project Manager to lead our Portfolio Management capability, bringing structure, governance and delivery oversight across the Global Finance Transformation portfolio.


You’ll work closely with our global Finance and Accounting leaders, technology teams and other cross-functional partners to turn strategic priorities into well-planned and effectively delivered transformation initiatives. This role would suit someone with strong technical programme and project management experience within finance who is comfortable working across enterprise systems, business processes and complex stakeholder groups.


This is a 12 month fixed term contract role.


What You’ll Do

  • Manage the Global Finance Transformation portfolio, maintaining clear visibility of priorities, timelines, dependencies, resources, risks, capacity and overall portfolio health.
  • Establish and maintain consistent approaches to project intake, prioritisation, planning and governance, translating strategic priorities into practical programmes, projects and roadmaps.
  • Lead complex Finance technology initiatives through planning, implementation and stabilisation, coordinating requirements, integrations, data, security, testing, deployment and operational readiness across functional and technical teams.
  • Build effective project governance, including integrated plans, portfolio reporting, RAID and decision logs, steering meetings and executive updates, while ensuring risks, dependencies and decisions are identified and addressed early.
  • Partner with Functional Systems Administration, Business Process Management and other stakeholders to align scope and priorities, create clear and structured requirements and documentation, improve delivery practices, align technology and process requirements, support resource planning and continuously improve how transformation initiatives are prioritised and delivered.

What We’re Looking For

  • 5+ years’ experience delivering complex technical programmes, projects or enterprise application initiatives within finance.

title: Data Engineer - (AWS Data Services)
description:
Australian Securities Exchange – Sydney NSW

ASX: Powering Australia's financial markets Why join the ASX?

When you join ASX, you're joining a company with a strong purpose - to power a stronger economic future by enabling a fair and dynamic marketplace for all.

In your new role, you'll be part of a leading global securities exchange with a strong brand. We are known for being a trusted market operator and an exciting data hub.

Want to know why we are a great place to work, click on the link to learn more.

www.asx.com.au/about/careers/a-great-place-to-work

We are more than a securities exchange!

The ASX team brings together talented people from a diverse range of disciplines.

We run critical market infrastructure, with 1 in 3 people employed within technology. Yet we have a unique complexity of roles across a range of disciplines such as operations, program delivery, financial products, investor engagement, risk and compliance.

We're proud to foster a workplace where diversity is celebrated and inclusion is part of our everyday culture. Our employee-led networks champion LGBTIQ+ inclusion, promote gender equality, accessibility and wellbeing, inspire giving and volunteering, and celebrate cultural and religious events, creating a sense of belonging for all. As an AWEI Bronze employer and member of the Champions of Change Coalition for gender equality, we're committed to a fair and inclusive workplace where everyone can thrive.

Your Team

The Derivatives Clearing Technology team is part of the Markets Technology division within ASX Technology. We are a trusted partner to the Clearing business, providing solutions that ensure a stable, efficient clearing and settlement facility for ASX's derivatives trading business.

Your responsibilities
  • Embedded within one of our line-of-business data and reporting teams, you will collaborate with stakeholders to understand their data objectives and champion the use and evolution of the central data platform.
  • You will work within a domain-aligned data product team consisting of line-of-business data owners and SMEs working alongside engineering resources provided by Technology.
  • You will be hands-on in the ingestion of ASX's core data assets by the product teams, their curation into source-aligned data products and the creation of consumable products in the form of files, reports, dashboards and APIs.
  • You will form part of a data engineering practice and community that will design and drive the adoption of standards, frameworks and best practices.
  • You will ensure data pipelines and products are designed and built to be run within a critical market infrastructure environment by the persistent product teams who build them.
Your experience and qualifications Must have
  • A hands-on engineer with deep experience working with a variety of AWS services for ingestion, curation, storage, orchestration, data management, analytics and distribution.
  • Good knowledge of data modelling and how to structure data within a data warehousing environment, while following best practice data management standards.
  • Solid data product architecture and solution design experience with a good working knowledge of DevSecOps practices to achieve high levels of automation across complex data pipelines.
  • Experience in real time streaming using Confluence Kafka and AWS services.
  • Experience with Airflow, AWS Glue, Apache Iceberg, Athena, RedShift and DataZone.
  • Experience in Data visualization tools such as Tableau/Power BI/QuickSight.
  • Solid experience in Python, Spark and Terraform/Terragrunt.
Nice to have
  • Experience working within a platform/product operating model where frameworks and development kits are leveraged to achieve standardisation, re-use and scale.
  • A working knowledge of data mesh/data product concepts with federated data ownership at the domain-level but operating on centralised platforms and governance.
  • Experience working in Capital Markets domain and understanding of derivative products.

We make hiring decisions based on your skills, capabilities and experience, and how you'll help us to live our values. We encourage you to apply even if you don't meet all the criteria of this role.

If you need any adjustments during the application or interview process to help you present your best self, please let us know at *******@asx.com.au.

At ASX Group, our diverse workforce is essential to build and maintain a fair and dynamic marketplace. We support flexible working and offer hybrid working options. Even if our roles are advertised as full-time, we encourage you to apply if you are interested in part-time or other flexible working arrangements.

We will arrange for successful candidates to have background checks, including reference and police checks, completed as part of the on-boarding process.

To be considered for this position, candidates must be legally authorised to work in Australia on a permanent basis without any restrictions.

title: Tax - Business Tax Services - Private Tax - International - Manager
description:
Location: Anywhere in Country

At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.

We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go. Join EY and help to build a better working world.

The opportunity

EY Private is a growing practice within the organization, and you’ll see that growth reflected in your career. With a diverse portfolio of interesting and challenging work, you’ll make an impact on some of the most technically demanding tax planning projects around. You’ll be part of a growing global team, acting as a key point of contact for a wide range of clients and colleagues. This is an opportunity for cross-border and cross-functional teaming. In return, you can expect plenty of support designed with your own personal skills and experience. EY is a dynamic place to develop not only your technical tax knowledge, but also your professional leadership and business acumen.

As a Manager in Private Tax, you will be at the forefront of providing personal and private tax advice and compliance support to cross-border multijurisdictional families. Key responsibilities include:

• Leading the delivery of tailored tax advice and compliance solutions for complex family and business structures.

• Supporting clients in wealth transfer, succession planning, and governance strategies.

• Navigating the unique challenges of multijurisdictional families and cross-border tax matters.

Your key responsibilities

Depending on your unique skills and ambitions, you could be managing various responsibilities, from technical planning and advising of clients that include high-profile individuals of extremely high net worth, and expectations to match. That will make you a trusted advisor and role model for our people across multiple teams, making this a great place to develop a diverse network of collaborative colleagues. Whatever you find yourself doing, you’ll personally coach and develop a highly trained team, all while handling activities with a focus on quality and commercial value.

The role offers the opportunity to guide and supervise professional employees or others to deliver complex technical initiatives, with accountability for performance and results. You’ll apply your depth of expertise to interpret internal and external issues, recommend quality solutions, and meet performance objectives and metrics in client service, risk management, sales, and business growth. Regular travel may be required to meet client needs, and you’ll actively participate in client working sessions. Analytical

Skills and attributes for success

• Apply rules related to controlled foreign corporations and passive foreign investment companies onto tax returns

• Application of foreign tax treaties and foreign tax credits

• Prepare form 1040, 1041 and 1065 and significant experience preparing or advising on domestic income and transfer tax and/or U.S. international informational returns (Forms 5471, 8858, 8865, 1040, 1041, 1065, 3520, 3520A)

• Team members with a compliance focus: prepare or review US federal and state tax returns for high net worth individual US citizens living abroad, US residents holding nonUS assets, or foreign nationals holding US assets. This role includes the preparation and review of the foreign info reporting requirements for cross border tax compliance such as foreign corporations, foreign partnerships, foreign disregarded entities and foreign trusts. Experience with relevant tax processing programs, and application of AI to data optimization and return process are essential skills.

• Team members with an advisory focus:

• Design pre-immigration tax plans

• Classification of trusts for US tax purposes, and review of forms 3520

• Assist with US exit planning

• FIRPTA

• Form the US tax piece of multi-jurisdictional inheritance/succession, including the use of trusts, both domestic and foreign

• Identifying foreign reporting obligations

• Prepare tax memorandums and opinions

• Translating complex data from a range of sources into client-ready insights and deliverables

• Support our Private practice with relevant tax analysis and address new trends/market opportunities.

• Work closely with rotators from our domestic teams, individuals on rotation from foreign affiliated firms, and our global deployment services team

• Building effective long-term relationships with our clients, understanding their unique needs to provide a tailored service

• Communicating complex tax issues to non-tax professionals and clients

• Maintaining your reputation in your field by constantly updating and sharing your technical and finest practice knowledge

• An appreciation of world affairs, cultures and protecting financial security.

Success in this role will be driven by your ability to manage complex projects, deliver high-quality solutions, and lead teams with broad visibility. Your analytical skills, commercial acumen, and ability to drive outcomes will set you apart.

• Demonstrated ability to manage and deliver processes, solutions, and projects while maintaining a focus on quality and risk management.

• Experience in continuous process improvement and identification of innovative solutions through research and analysis.

• Proven ability to guide and supervise others to deliver complex technical initiatives, with accountability for performance and results.

• Depth of expertise in interpreting internal and external issues to recommend quality solutions.

• Track record of meeting performance objectives and metrics in client service, risk management, sales, and business growth.

To qualify for the role you must have

• A bachelor's degree in a related field, supported by significant tax and a CPA certification or membership in The Bar; Minimum of 5 years of work experience in professional services or professional tax organization

• A thorough understanding of estate and wealth planning; as well as experience with federal and state personal and trust income tax

• Excellent collaboration and negotiation skills, and the confidence to challenge senior colleagues and stakeholders from a diverse range of backgrounds

• A thorough understanding of automated tax processing systems and laws within your area of technical professionalism

• Experience managing budgets and projects

• Bachelor’s degree required (4-year degree).

• Typically, no less than 5 - 6 years relevant experience.

Specialized Skills Required:

• International Tax Planning

• Tax Research and Analysis

• Client trust and value

• Emotional Agility

• Leading teams

• Managing change

• Negotiation and influencing

• Global Mindset

Ideally you will also have

• A proven record in high net-worth tax planning

• A proven record in a professional services environment

• Experience in coaching and mentoring junior colleagues

• Executive presence and business development skills

• Strong analytical skills and attention to detail

• The ability to adapt your work style to work with both internal and client team members

• Experience leading workstream delivery and tracking project status.

• Experience managing engagement economics and identifying opportunities for additional services.

What we look for

We seek top performers who are passionate about delivering high-quality solutions, thrive in dynamic environments, and demonstrate strong leadership and analytical skills. The ideal candidate is adaptable, commercially minded, and committed to continuous learning and innovation.

What we offer you
At EY, we’ll develop you with future-focused skills and equip you with world-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams. Learn more.

  • We offer a comprehensive compensation and benefits package where you’ll be rewarded based on your performance and recognized for the value you bring to the business. The base salary range for this job in all geographic locations in the US is $116,200 to $212,900. The base salary range for New York City Metro Area, Washington State and California (excluding Sacramento) is $139,400 to $242,000. Individual salaries within those ranges are determined through a wide variety of factors including but not limited to education, experience, knowledge, skills and geography. In addition, our Total Rewards package includes medical and dental coverage, pension and 401(k) plans, and a wide range of paid time off options.
  • Join us in our team-led and leader-enabled hybrid model. Our expectation is for most people in external, client serving roles to work together in person 60% of the time over the course of an engagement, project or year.
  • Under our flexible vacation policy, you’ll decide how much vacation time you need based on your own personal circumstances. You’ll also be granted time off for designated EY Paid Holidays, Winter/Summer breaks, Personal/Family Care, and other leaves of absence when needed to support your physical, financial, and emotional well-being.

title: Integrated Systems Planning Strategy Senior Analyst / Consultant
description:
Arizona Public Service generates reliable, affordable and clean energy for 2.7 million Arizonans. As the state’s largest and longest-serving energy provider, our more than 6,000 dedicated employees power our vision of creating a sustainable energy future for Arizona.

Summary

The Integrated Systems Planning Strategy Senior Analyst / Consultant serves as a key strategic integrator between technical planning organizations and business leadership by integrating information from across the organization into a cohesive story of APS's future system needs, investments and strategic priorities. Reports to the Manager of Integrated System Planning (ISP) and supports the development, maintenance and governance of APS's Integrated System Plan. Coordinates with stakeholders across multiple business areas to communicate portfolio-level impacts, dependencies, risks and opportunities that influence strategic planning decisions. Functions with substantial independence in developing executive communication, strategic narratives and planning recommendations. Exercises seasoned judgement in resolving complex planning issues, influencing stakeholders and translating diverse planning perspectives into actionable recommendations for leadership.

Minimum Requirements

Integrated Systems Planning Strategy Senior Analyst

  • A four-year Bachelors Degree in business, communications, finance, economics, engineering, project management, public administration or other job-related field from an accredited college or university
  • Plus five (5) years related experience in executive communications, business analysis, reporting, project management, strategic planning and/or consulting.
  • In lieu of bachelors degree, combination of college coursework and/or experience business analysis, reporting, project management, strategic planning, consulting and/or communications equaling 9 years.

Integrated Systems Planning Strategy Consultant

  • A four-year Bachelors Degree in business, communications, finance, economics, engineering, project management, public administration or other job-related field from an accredited college or university
  • Plus seven (7) years related experience in executive communications, business analysis, reporting, project management, strategic planning and/or consulting.
  • In lieu of bachelors degree, combination of college coursework and/or experience business analysis, reporting, project management, strategic planning, consulting and/or communications equaling 11 years.

Preferred Skills, Knowledge and Qualifications:

  • Ability to independently evaluate highly complex, ambiguous and cross-functional planning issues and formulate strategic recommendations with minimal direction.
  • Exceptional communication, presentation and stakeholder engagement skills, including ability to develop executive-level communications, strategic narratives and decision-support materials.
  • Advanced proficiency in Microsoft PowerPoint, Excel and other Microsoft 365 applications.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Power BI or equivalent data visualization tools.
  • Ability to translate complex technical, operational and financial information into clear, actionable insights for leadership audiences.
  • Experience supporting executive leadership, governance forums and strategic decision-making processes.
  • Knowledge of utility operations, integrated planning, resource planning, transmission planning, capital planning and/or portfolio management.
  • Ability to manage multiple assignments, competing priorities and cross-functional stakeholder relationships.

Major Accountabilities

1) Develops and maintains executive reporting and decision-support materials that provide transparency into Integrated System Plan assumptions, portfolio changes, risks and dependencies. Ensures communication materials reflect validated information and clearly communicate implications for execution feasibility, reliability, affordability, defensibility and strategic priority alignment.

2) Coordinates with stakeholders across Resource Planning, Transmission Planning, New Generation, Finance, System Operations, Regulatory Affairs and other business units as necessary to gather, document, analyze, organize and communicate information supporting strategic planning activities and leadership decision-making.

3) Researches, analyzes and summarizes information related to planning activities, business initiatives, capital investments, risks, assumptions, emerging issues and other business analysis activities supporting the Integrated System Plan.

4) Synthesizes planning analyses and stakeholder input into executive-level recommendations, decision alternatives, strategic narratives and decision-support materials supporting leadership review of resource plans, transmission plans, capital investments and portfolio priorities.

5) Creates visualizations, graphics, reporting formats, presentation materials and strategic narratives that improve communication of complex planning concepts, portfolio impacts and business tradeoffs supporting the Integrated System Plan.

6) Supports governance and change-management processes associated with the Integrated System Plan through documentation and communication of key decisions, assumptions, impacts and portfolio changes.

7) Participates in cross-functional project teams and planning initiatives to drive organizational alignment and support integration of planning assumptions, priorities and portfolio objectives.

8) Monitors industry, regulatory, market and technology developments that may influence long-term system planning strategies, portfolio priorities and investment decisions.

Export Compliance / EEO Statement

This position may require access to and/or use of information subject to control under the Department of Energy's Part 810 Regulations (10 CFR Part 810), the Export Administration Regulations (EAR) (15 CFR Parts 730 through 774), or the International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR) (22 CFR Chapter I, Subchapter M Part 120) (collectively, 'U.S. Export Control Laws'). title: Teamlead podiumtechniek
description:
Jeugd- en muziekcentrum Kinky Star heeft zich de voorbije 29 jaar onlosmakelijk verbonden met de muzikale en culturele uitstraling van Gent. Steeds tastend naar de grenzen van het huidige niet-commerciële muzieklandschap, is Kinky Star een welbekende naam geworden binnen de muzikale underground en veelal een eerste speelkans voor beginnende bands.

De organisatie biedt eveneens ruimte voor vrijwilligersinitiatief, waardoor het steeds de nadruk legt op het werven, betrekken, opleiden, motiveren en begeleiden van jonge vrijwilligers. Naast de projecten JonGeduld en Plan.K, specifiek gericht op respectievelijk bandcoaching en ondernemingszin, is er een uitgebreide basiswerking: wekelijks worden er 3-5 concerten, raves, workshops, ... georganiseerd, waarbij alles van bookings en productie tot bar gedragen wordt door jonge, geëngageerde vrijwilligers, ondersteund door de beroepskrachten.

Functieomschrijving

Kinky Star is op zoek naar een teamlead podiumtechniek om in te staan voor de coördinatie en verdere uitbouw van ons team van vrijwillige geluidstechnici.

De focus van je job ligt hem in het werven van nieuwe vrijwilligers, organiseren van opleidings- en bijschavingsmomenten waar je toekomstige en/of huidige vrijwilligers de kneepjes van het vak leert, en het instaan voor de wekelijkse planning. In gevallen waar je geen beschikbare vrijwilliger vindt, ben je niet bang om zelf de mengtafel te bedienen.

Daarnaast volg je mee de productie op: via onze productietool Stager volg je tijdig de advancing van aankomende concerten op, en controleer je de riders die bands ons toesturen. Bookings en programmatie zijn een gedeelde verantwoordelijkheid, maar er is zeker de mogelijkheid om daarop door te wegen.

Tot slot draag je je steentje bij aan de algemene werking van Kinky Star; denk aan het opnemen van een permanentie, tellen van de kassa’s, shifts als verantwoordelijke tijdens de Gentse Feesten, … Door middel van een beurtrol worden deze algemene taken door het hele team gedragen.

Takenpakket

  • Administratief: je verzorgt de inroostering van vrijwilligers voor techniek;
  • Educatief: je voorziet op regelmatige basis opleidingsmomenten voor nieuwe vrijwilligers, volgt bestaande vrijwilligers op en staat open voor vragen; je werkt actief aan werving van nieuwe vrijwilligers;
  • Techniek: je staat in voor het onderhoud en de goede werking van het technische materiaal en het podium; bij gaten in de planning spring je zelf in als geluidstechnicus;
  • Productie: je volgt advancing en riders van bands op;
  • Algemeen: je draagt je steentje bij aan de algemene werking van Kinky Star

Profiel

  • Je hebt ruime ervaring als geluidstechnicus.
  • Je beschikt bij voorkeur over (vrijwilligers)ervaring in het jeugdwerk en/of de culturele sector.
  • Je voelt je thuis in een dynamische omgeving en kan vlot schakelen zonder de korte- en langetermijndoelen te verliezen.
  • Je bewaart gemakkelijk het overzicht over het grotere geheel en kan prioriteiten stellen die aansluiten bij de missie en visie van Kinky Star.
  • Je vertrekt vanuit een open jeugdwerkvisie en hebt oprechte aandacht voor alle vrijwilligers en teamleden.
  • Je werkt zelfstandig, maar hecht veel belang aan een gedragen en gedeelde visie.
  • Je bent communicatief sterk en weet mensen te motiveren en te verbinden.
  • Je hebt een kritische en reflectieve houding ten opzichte van je eigen werking en gaat actief op zoek naar groeikansen.

Wat verwachten we van jou

  • Je bent bereid om regelmatig avond- en weekendwerk te doen en ziet dit als een meerwaarde om aanwezig en aanspreekbaar te zijn voor vrijwilligers.
  • Je bent zichtbaar op de werkvloer en bouwt actief aan vertrouwen en betrokkenheid binnen het vrijwilligersteam.
  • Je gaat actief aan de slag met meningen, ideeën en feedback van vrijwilligers en betrekt hen bij het grotere geheel dat Kinky Star is.
  • Je stimuleert eigenaarschap en participatie door vrijwilligers mee te laten denken en bouwen aan de werking.
  • Je signaleert noden en kansen binnen de werking en vertaalt deze, samen met vrijwilligers en teamleden, naar concrete acties.
  • Je bent beschikbaar tijdens de Gentse Feesten-periode

This is not a delivery management role. You’ll be actively involved in full-stack, full-cycle software development, contributing to architecture, writing production code, reviewing pull requests, improving platform reliability and helping your team ship high-quality solutions from idea to production. Working closely with Product and Design, you’ll lead a squad of 3-5 engineers to create secure, scalable and intuitive home lending experiences that make applying for a home loan simpler and faster for our customers.

You’ll combine technical leadership with people leadership, coaching engineers while remaining deeply connected to the technology and outcomes your squad delivers. Owning the entire software lifecycle, you’ll help shape technical strategy, champion modern engineering practices, drive AI-powered development and automation, and ensure your team builds, runs and continuously improves the products they own. Your impact will extend beyond your squad as you help uplift engineering standards across Home Buying, influence technical direction and contribute to one of CommBank’s most important customer journeys while continuing to grow as an accomplished software engineering leader.

See yourself in our team:

The Apply With Ease Crew sits at the heart of CommBank’s Home Buying Domain, building the digital platforms and services that power one of Australia’s most important customer journeys, securing a home loan. Our technology enables customers, lenders and associates to seamlessly progress from application through to approval, removing complexity, reducing friction and helping customers achieve home ownership faster. Working at scale, we design and operate secure, cloud-native, API-driven solutions that handle millions of customer interactions while maintaining the highest standards of reliability, performance and security. As part of a highly collaborative crew of engineers, product specialists and designers, you’ll tackle complex challenges across customer experience, automation, decisioning and platform modernisation. We embrace modern engineering practices, AI-powered development, automation and continuous delivery to accelerate innovation and improve outcomes. Every improvement we deliver has a direct and measurable impact on customers, creating simpler experiences, faster decisions and a more intuitive path to home ownership.

We’re interested in hearing from people who:

  • Have deep full-stack and/or backend engineering expertise with the technical credibility to lead architecture, design and delivery of secure, scalable customer platforms.

  • Lead a small team of engineers while remaining hands-on with coding, architecture and engineering delivery, fostering a culture of ownership, technical excellence and continuous improvement.

  • Own outcomes end-to-end, partnering with Product and Design to solve customer problems from discovery through to production.

  • Champion full-cycle engineering with a “you build it, you own it” mindset, driving accountability for reliability, observability, security and operational excellence.

  • Bring proven experience designing and operating distributed systems, APIs and cloud-native platforms at scale.

  • Drive modern engineering practices including CI/CD, automated testing, DevOps and cloud engineering to enable safe, frequent delivery.

  • Influence engineering strategy, architecture, standards and capability uplift across teams and the broader engineering community.

  • Make pragmatic technical decisions that balance delivery speed, engineering quality, security, risk and long-term platform sustainability.

  • Are passionate about AI-Powered Engineering, automation and developer experience, using modern tools and practices to improve productivity, quality and delivery outcomes.

Tech skills

We don’t expect you to know everything, but experience in several of the following will set you up for success:

  • Front End: TypeScript, React, Next.js

  • Back End: Node.js, TypeScript, REST APIs, distributed systems, scalable and secure services, Next.js

  • Cloud & Infrastructure: AWS, Azure, Docker, Kubernetes

  • DevOps & CI/CD: GitHub Actions, Jenkins, TeamCity, automated deployment pipelines, CI/CD practices

  • Database: PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQL Server, AWS DocumentDB

  • Monitoring & Observability: Prometheus, Grafana, Splunk, AWS CloudWatch

  • Testing & Quality: TDD, BDD, automated testing, integration testing, service virtualisation

  • AI & GenAI: GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, Codex, AI-assisted software engineering tools

Om jobbet

Vi är Göteborg. Nu behöver vi dig med god kompetens inom nätverk till vårt team! Våra leverantörer är branschens främsta aktörer och inkluderar bland annat HPE, BlueCat, Palo Alto, Algosec, F5, Microsoft, Cisco, VMware och Commvault.

I rollen kommer du att tillhöra enheten IT-kommunikation, som i dagsläget består av 26 personer och ansvarar för nätverkskommunikationen för de gemensamma tjänsterna i Göteborgs stad som Intraservice levererar.
